items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: Stone was not the same with me.

ctx.x: What about this guy, who's called Fritz?

Fritz had a good term, but not compared to none of the people. He was a... Fritz had a term, something like... I used to say something like Edmund Hall or something. Sure. That's sort of a tone yet. But, uh, it was very fast. And you knew what he was doing. But for a tone, you can have a tone like it. You take Edmund Hall or a tone like it, but it was more... Raw than some new musicians that you would get. Although I'm not knocking them easy at first class musicians. Stone was not the same with me.
Yeah. What about Fritz's ideas? Well, I think... Man, I think it was Chris...
